features.statement: Page has exactly one h1 containing the hero headline, with bold weight at very large size.
Card and article titles use h3 beneath section h2 headings, giving a clean sequential heading hierarchy.
Content is wrapped in main, section and article landmark elements rather than only header, nav and footer.
Document title is title-case brand name, en dash separator, then sentence-case tagline.
Typography relies solely on a system-ui font stack, with no web fonts, icon fonts or handwritten faces.
Section headings (h2) are bold and large instead of light weight.
Body text uses a generous line height around 1.6 on a 16px base.
Accent color is a deeper, muted blue paired with dark navy bands and pale-blue tinted surfaces.
Page opens with a compact dark-blue utility bar holding text social links and text-size buttons.
Navigation links are title-case dark text without dropdown carets, on the same row as the logo.
Hero is a two-column split with text on the left and a photo on the right.
Hero image has rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, the only shadowed element.
Images carry descriptive alt text for meaningful images and empty alt for decorative icons.
Part of the hero headline is highlighted in accent blue while the rest stays dark.
Hero actions are bordered rounded tiles each ending with a right-arrow glyph.
Microcopy uses sentence case rather than all lowercase.
Category icons are small and left-aligned, with small bold letter-spaced uppercase blue labels.
Groups of items are separate pale-tinted cards with thin borders and rounded corners.
Latest content is shown as a three-column card grid on a tinted section background.
Article titles are dark bold headings rather than blue links.
Sponsor logos are small, left-aligned within bordered rounded tiles, including text-only tiles.
Secondary links are plain italic blue text links instead of decorative tabs.
Footer is split into a light tinted multi-column band and a dark navy bottom band for policy links.
Newsletter signup is a minimal single email input inline with a rounded button.
RSS link is a small icon accompanied by an explicit text label.
Corners use consistent moderate 6–15px radii with no pill shapes.
Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox.
Buttons on dark bars are translucent white with small radius rather than solid color.
Logo is a text wordmark with one word colored in accent blue.
Markup is lean: a single script, no external stylesheets, minimal inline styles and few classes.
In-text links are blue without underline.
Trust certification seal sits in a light tile with blue links and no external-link icon.
Content sits in a centered fixed-width container with generous spacing between sections.
